chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. 'Isa b. 'Ubayd narrated to us from Yunus b. 'Abd al-Rahman from Abu Jamila from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
Allah, Exalted is His Majesty, said: O My saintly servants! Find felicity in your worship of Me in this world, for you will be delighted by it in Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What did Allah say to His saintly servants about worship according to Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: This is a Hadith Qudsi (Divine saying) transmitted through the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) via Imam al-Sadiq from his forefathers. God addresses His truthful and devout servants, commanding them to take pleasure in worship during their earthly lives, with the promise that this same worship will be a source of delight for them in Paradise. This teaching reframes worship not as a burden but as a spiritual pleasure that carries over into the afterlife.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd narrated to us from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from Abi Jamila from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Allah said: O My saintly servants! Find felicity in your worship of Me in this world, for you will be delighted by it in Paradise.
